def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    valid = rem >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(rem, -np.inf)
    safe_rem = np.where(rem == 0, 1e-8, rem)
    scores[valid] = np.log(item / safe_rem[valid])
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remainder = np.mod(bins, item)
    valid = bins >= item
    result = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    # Avoid division by zero when remainder is 0 (perfect fit)
    mask = remainder > 0
    result[valid & mask] = item / remainder[valid & mask]
    return result

    Args:

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    return np.where(remaining >= 0, -remaining, -np.inf)
